senses.gloss: m.mayish, name of a tree, Celtis (v. Löw Pfl., p. 250) ‘a tall tree with fruits like myrtle-berries’. Sifra Vayikra, N’dab., Par. 4, ch. VI; Tosef. Men. IX, 14; Tam. 29ᵇ.—Pl. מַיְישִׁין fruits of the mayish.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 72">Gen. R. s. 72</cite>, beg. (expl. <cite ref="D00203"><he>דּוֹדָאִים</he></cite>).
